title: Information-compute ratio
caption: Sample value priced in compute: gain per unit of training FLOPs. Turns 'is this example useful' into 'is it worth the FLOPs it burns' — the selection counterpart of the training chapter's time accounting.

symbols.name: information-compute ratio
symbols.meaning: learning signal per unit of training compute

symbols.name: measured gain
symbols.meaning: accuracy points or loss drop attributable to the data

symbols.name: compute bill
symbols.meaning: FLOPs spent processing those examples

title: Marginal ICR decay
caption: The chapter's illustrative model: as the dataset doubles, the next FLOP's learning yield halves. Explains why adding data buys less each pass — the ICR frontier bends down.

symbols.name: marginal ICR
symbols.meaning: learning value of the next unit of data at the margin

symbols.name: per-sample compute
symbols.meaning: forward + backward + update cost for one example

symbols.name: dataset size
symbols.meaning: corpus size already consumed — repeats count against it

title: The selection inequality
caption: The chapter's break-even law: selection counts as an optimization only when scoring plus subset training beats full training at matched quality and coverage. Scorer cost and refresh rate decide — not the retained fraction.

symbols.name: selection time
symbols.meaning: wall-clock cost of the selection pass (scoring, hashing, coordination)

symbols.name: subset training time
symbols.meaning: training time on the retained subset at matched quality

symbols.name: full training time
symbols.meaning: training time on the unpruned corpus at the same quality

title: Data compression ratio
caption: How much smaller the selected set is at a target accuracy — a compression claim, not a quality claim. DCR 5 means the coreset hits target on 20% of the data; coverage must be validated separately.

symbols.name: data compression ratio
symbols.meaning: compression achieved by the subset at target accuracy

symbols.name: full size
symbols.meaning: full dataset size

symbols.name: subset size
symbols.meaning: selected subset size at the target accuracy

title: Constrained coreset budget
caption: Per-class/slice coverage floors are applied before spending the score budget. If summed floors exceed the budget, no ranking can fix it — the selection plan itself must change.

symbols.name: budget
symbols.meaning: total examples the subset may hold

symbols.name: floor of class c
symbols.meaning: minimum keep for class or slice c, whatever its score

title: Foundation-model break-even
latex: C_{\mathrm{pretrain}} + N \cdot C_{\mathrm{finetune}} \le N \cdot C_{\mathrm{scratch}} \;\Rightarrow\; N \ge \frac{C_{\mathrm{pretrain}}}{C_{\mathrm{scratch}} - C_{\mathrm{finetune}}}
caption: The amortization law for one shared pretrained run: 10,000 + 50N <= 1,000N GPU-hours gives N >= 11 tasks in the book's worked scenario. Below that task count, self-supervision is the more expensive option.

symbols.name: pretraining cost
symbols.meaning: one-time self-supervised run — 10,000 GPU-hours

symbols.name: fine-tune cost
symbols.meaning: per-task fine-tuning — 50 GPU-hours

symbols.name: scratch cost
symbols.meaning: per-task training from scratch — 1,000 GPU-hours

symbols.name: task count
symbols.meaning: downstream tasks sharing the pretraining

title: Amortized selection ROI
caption: Fixed curation cost spread across every run in the campaign. The book's worked dedup pipeline: -82% ROI at one run, break-even near five, +809% by fifty — the same fixed bill divided differently.

symbols.name: run count
symbols.meaning: training runs reusing the selection pipeline

symbols.name: per-run saving
symbols.meaning: savings per run from the retained subset

symbols.name: setup cost
symbols.meaning: one-time pipeline engineering + preprocessing cost

title: Data echoing fill
caption: Reuse a prepared batch e times to recover accelerator cycles the slow host strands. The useful factor is the pipeline ratio itself — echo only exists when the host is the slow stage (R > 1); below that it recovers nothing.

symbols.name: echo factor
symbols.meaning: batch re-uses before the host must produce the next

symbols.name: pipeline time
symbols.meaning: host preparation per batch (decode + augment)

symbols.name: step time
symbols.meaning: accelerator step time per batch

symbols.name: pipeline ratio
symbols.meaning: echo has headroom only above 1
